import json
from qb.subsequences import subsequences

CASES = [[[1, 5, 3], [[1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 4], [1, 3, 4], [2, 3, 4]]], [[30, -2, 3], []], [[30, 2, 3], []], [[4, 10, 4], [[4, 5, 6, 7], [4, 5, 6, 8], [4, 5, 6, 9], [4, 5, 7, 8], [4, 5, 7, 9], [4, 5, 8, 9], [4, 6, 7, 8], [4, 6, 7, 9], [4, 6, 8, 9], [4, 7, 8, 9], [5, 6, 7, 8], [5, 6, 7, 9], [5, 6, 8, 9], [5, 7, 8, 9], [6, 7, 8, 9]]], [[4, 10, 6], [[4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]]]]


def check():
    for input_data, expected in CASES:
        got = subsequences(*input_data)
        assert json.loads(json.dumps(got, default=list)) == expected, "subsequences(%r) returned %r, expected %r" % (input_data, got, expected)
